# A clause that does not signpost its pair back

`Policy: pol-BACK` `DRAFT`

## Purpose

`pol-ONEW` signposts this clause as the other side of one obligation. This clause shares its id and says nothing
of it, so a reader here never learns the pair exists.

## Scope

This fixture only. It exercises `pair-one-way`.

## Clauses

| Id       | Clause                                  | Alignment |
|----------|-----------------------------------------|-----------|
| `PAIRED` | **MUST** keep a record of each release  |           |
